natural: spring rain is as precious as oil

meaning.en: Spring rain is extremely valuable because crops need water just when the fields are sown and the seedlings are growing.
meaning.zh: 春天正是播种和幼苗生长需要水分的时候，春雨对庄稼十分珍贵。

equivalents: April showers bring May flowers
rain in spring is liquid gold

examples.zh: 春雨贵如油，这场雨来得正是时候。
examples.en: Spring rain is worth its weight in oil, and this shower came at just the right moment.

examples.zh: 农民说春雨贵如油，纷纷下地播种。
examples.en: Farmers say spring rain is as precious as oil and went into the fields to sow.

usage.en: A farming saying from the north, where spring is often dry. Also used for any help that arrives just when it is most needed. The phrase 春雨如油 is a common shorter form.
usage.zh: 北方农谚，北方春季常干旱。也比喻及时雨般的帮助。常说成“春雨如油”。

pinyin: qīng míng duàn xuě, gǔ yǔ duàn shuāng
literal: Qingming · end · snow, Guyu · end · frost
natural: snow ends by Qingming, frost ends by Guyu

meaning.en: By the Qingming solar term (about 5 April) snow is over, and by Guyu (about 20 April) the last frost has gone, so it is safe to plant tender crops.
meaning.zh: 清明（约4月5日）前后不再下雪，谷雨（约4月20日）前后不再有霜，可以放心种植怕冻的作物。

equivalents: the last frost is gone by late April
safe to sow after the last frost

examples.zh: 清明断雪，谷雨断霜，老农开始准备下种了。
examples.en: Snow ends at Qingming and frost at Guyu, so the old farmer started preparing to sow.

examples.zh: 爷爷说清明断雪，谷雨断霜，今年的春耕可以放心了。
examples.en: Grandpa said snow is gone after Qingming and frost after Guyu, so this year's ploughing was safe to proceed.

usage.en: A northern Chinese farming saying that ties two spring solar terms to the end of cold weather. It is a rule of thumb that varies by region and year.
usage.zh: 北方农谚，把两个春季节气与寒冷结束联系起来。属经验之谈，各地各年有差异。

pinyin: chūn zhēng rì, xià zhēng shí
literal: spring · compete for · day, summer · compete for · hour
natural: spring races by the day, summer by the hour

meaning.en: Farm work in spring and summer is tied to narrow windows: sowing must be done within days in spring, and harvesting within hours in the summer rush.
meaning.zh: 春季播种要抢日子，夏季收割要抢时辰，农事耽误不得。

equivalents: make hay while the sun shines
time and tide wait for no man

examples.zh: 春争日，夏争时，大家别拖，抓紧抢收。
examples.en: Spring races by the day and summer by the hour, so no dawdling: let's get the harvest in quickly.

examples.zh: 春争日，夏争时，错过农时就要减产。
examples.en: Spring and summer farm work can't wait: miss the season and the yield falls.

usage.en: Often extended to 一年农事不宜迟; used figuratively for any task with a tight deadline.
usage.zh: 常接“一年农事不宜迟”；也比喻有紧迫时限的任何工作。

text: 春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子
pinyin: chūn zhòng yī lì sù, qiū shōu wàn kē zǐ
literal: spring · plant · one · grain · millet, autumn · harvest · ten thousand · grains · seeds
natural: plant one grain of millet in spring and harvest ten thousand in autumn

meaning.en: A small investment of effort in spring can yield an enormous harvest in autumn.
meaning.zh: 春天播下一粒种子，秋天可以收获成千上万颗粮食。

equivalents: you reap what you sow
small seeds, great harvests

examples.zh: “春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子”，我们要珍惜每一粒粮食。
examples.en: '春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子': we should cherish every grain of food.

examples.zh: 老师以“春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子”来教育学生，努力总有回报。
examples.en: The teacher used '春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子' to teach the pupils that effort always pays off.

story.en: The Tang poet Li Shen wrote in his poem 'Sympathy for the Peasants': 'Plant one grain in spring, harvest ten thousand seeds in autumn. Not a field in the four seas lies idle, yet the farmers still starve.' The poem is part of every Chinese child's early education.
story.zh: 唐代诗人李绅《悯农二首》：“春种一粒粟，秋收万颗子。四海无闲田，农夫犹饿死。”该诗是中国儿童的启蒙诗篇。

usage.en: First line of a well-known children's poem; used in lessons on thrift and on the link between effort and reward. The poem's real point is the farmers' hardship.
usage.zh: 著名儿童启蒙诗的首句；常用于讲节约粮食和勤劳有回报。全诗本意是同情农民的艰辛。

natural: for the diligent, spring comes early

meaning.en: Hard-working people begin work early, so for them the spring season is felt sooner and the harvest is greater.
meaning.zh: 勤劳的人起步早，他们先感到春天的到来，收获也更多。

equivalents: the early bird catches the worm
diligence is rewarded early

examples.zh: 人勤春来早，村民们天不亮就下地了。
examples.en: For the diligent spring comes early, and the villagers were in the fields before dawn.

examples.zh: 人勤春来早，他提前开始备考，成绩果然领先。
examples.en: The diligent see spring early: he started revision ahead of time and his results were indeed ahead.

usage.en: A farm saying that is also a favourite on posters and New Year couplets; the usual pair is 人勤春来早，春早人更勤.
usage.zh: 农谚，也常见于春联和标语，常与“春早人更勤”对举。

pinyin: chūn léi xiǎng, wàn wù zhǎng
literal: spring · thunder · sounds, ten thousand · things · grow
natural: when spring thunder rolls, all things grow

meaning.en: The first spring thunder wakes up insects and brings rain, and plants burst into growth.
meaning.zh: 春天第一声雷响起，惊醒虫类，带来雨水，万物开始生长。

equivalents: spring thunder wakes the world
the first thunder brings new life

examples.zh: 春雷响，万物长，果树全都冒出了新芽。
examples.en: With spring thunder everything grows, and the fruit trees all put out new buds.

examples.zh: 春雷响，万物长，惊蛰一过，田里就热闹起来。
examples.en: When spring thunder rolls everything grows, and once Jingzhe is past the fields come to life.

usage.en: Tied to the solar term 惊蛰 (Awakening of Insects, around 5 March), when thunder is traditionally said to wake hibernating creatures.
usage.zh: 与节气“惊蛰”（约3月5日）相关，传统认为春雷惊醒冬眠的动物。

pinyin: chūn fēn qiū fēn, zhòu yè píng fēn
literal: spring equinox · autumn equinox, day · night · equally · divide
natural: at the spring and autumn equinoxes day and night are equal

meaning.en: On the spring and autumn equinoxes (about 20 March and 23 September) daytime and night-time are almost equal in length.
meaning.zh: 春分和秋分（约3月20日和9月23日）白昼和黑夜几乎一样长。

equivalents: equal day and equal night
equinoxes balance day and night

examples.zh: 春分秋分，昼夜平分，今天白天和黑夜一样长。
examples.en: Day and night are equal at the equinoxes, and today they are of equal length.

examples.zh: 老师讲了春分秋分，昼夜平分的道理，同学们用地球仪演示。
examples.en: The teacher explained that day and night balance at the equinoxes and the pupils demonstrated it with a globe.

usage.en: The sun is directly above the equator on the equinox. Strictly speaking, day is slightly longer than night, but the saying is a handy rule of thumb. Common in primary-school science lessons.
usage.zh: 春分秋分时太阳直射赤道。严格说白昼略长于黑夜，但这句话是方便的口诀，常见于小学科学课。

pinyin: xiǎo shǔ dà shǔ, shàng zhēng xià zhǔ
literal: Minor Heat · Major Heat, above · steam · below · boil
natural: Minor Heat and Major Heat: steamed from above, boiled from below

meaning.en: In the hottest weeks of summer the sun steams you from above and the ground boils you from below.
meaning.zh: 盛夏最热的时候，天上像蒸笼，地下像煮锅。

equivalents: steamed from above, boiled from below
the dog days of summer

examples.zh: 小暑大暑，上蒸下煮，大家一定要防暑。
examples.en: In the hottest weeks you're steamed from above and boiled from below, so everyone must guard against heatstroke.

examples.zh: 小暑大暑，上蒸下煮，空调开了一整天。
examples.en: The air conditioner ran all day in the steaming heat of Minor and Major Heat.

usage.en: Refers to the two hottest solar terms in July (小暑 about 7 July, 大暑 about 22 July), when the weather is also humid.
usage.zh: 指七月最热的两个节气（小暑约7月7日，大暑约7月22日），此时天气闷热潮湿。

pinyin: xiǎo mǎn xiǎo mǎn, mài lì jiàn mǎn
literal: Lesser Fullness · Lesser Fullness, wheat · grain · gradually · full
natural: at Lesser Fullness the wheat grains are slowly filling out

meaning.en: Around 21 May the wheat grains begin to fill but are not yet fully ripe, which is how the solar term 小满 got its name.
meaning.zh: 约5月21日，麦粒开始灌浆饱满，但尚未成熟，这是节气“小满”名称的由来。

equivalents: the grains are filling out
almost, but not quite ripe

examples.zh: 小满小满，麦粒渐满，再过半个月就可以收割了。
examples.en: At Lesser Fullness the wheat grains are filling out, and in another fortnight it can be harvested.

examples.zh: 爷爷站在田埂上说：小满小满，麦粒渐满。
examples.en: Grandpa stood at the edge of the field and said that at Lesser Fullness the grains are filling.

usage.en: Explains the name of the solar term 小满: 'little full', unlike 'full' (大满), which Chinese tradition avoids as it implies decline.
usage.zh: 解释节气“小满”的含义：只是“小满”，而非“大满”，传统上满则招损，宜留余地。

pinyin: máng zhòng máng zhòng, lián shōu dài zhòng
literal: Grain in Ear · Grain in Ear, reap · together with · sow
natural: at Grain in Ear, reaping and sowing go together

meaning.en: Around 6 June farmers are harvesting winter wheat and sowing rice and late crops at the same time, so it is the busiest season.
meaning.zh: 约6月6日，农民一边收割麦子，一边播种水稻等晚季作物，是最忙的时节。

equivalents: harvest and plant at once
the busiest time on the farm

examples.zh: 芒种芒种，连收带种，家家户户都忙得脚不沾地。
examples.en: Reaping and sowing go together at Grain in Ear, and every household is rushed off its feet.

examples.zh: 芒种芒种，连收带种，学校放了忙假让孩子回家帮忙。
examples.en: With reaping and sowing together at Grain in Ear, the school gave a holiday so children could help at home.

usage.en: 芒 in 芒种 means the awn (beard) of wheat; 种 can mean 'seed' or 'to sow', hence the wordplay. 种 in the second phrase is read zhòng.
usage.zh: “芒种”的“芒”指麦芒，“种”既指种子也指播种，有双关意。后一个“种”读 zhòng。

natural: at White Dew, do not bare your body

meaning.en: After the White Dew solar term (about 8 September) the weather turns cool, so people should cover up and stop going about in summer clothes.
meaning.zh: 白露（约9月8日）以后天气转凉，不宜再赤膊或穿露身的夏装。

equivalents: time to cover up
autumn chill is here, so dress warmly

examples.zh: 白露身不露，天气转凉了，快把外套穿上。
examples.en: At White Dew you shouldn't bare your body, so put on your jacket now the weather has turned cool.

examples.zh: 奶奶提醒孩子白露身不露，别再穿短裤了。
examples.en: Grandma reminded the child that you shouldn't go bare at White Dew and told him to stop wearing shorts.

usage.en: A health saying from folk tradition, often followed by 寒露脚不露 (at Cold Dew do not leave the feet bare); the exact version differs by region. Often said by parents and grandparents.
usage.zh: 民间养生谚语，常接“寒露脚不露”，各地说法有差异，多由长辈叮嘱晚辈。

natural: at Frost's Descent, all the plants die

meaning.en: By the Shuangjiang solar term (about 23 October) the first hard frost arrives and kills off the grasses and tender plants.
meaning.zh: 霜降（约10月23日）时出现第一场严霜，各种草木和怕冻作物凋萎。

equivalents: frost kills everything green
the first hard frost ends the growing season

examples.zh: 霜降杀百草，菜园里的辣椒都枯了。
examples.en: Frost's Descent kills all the plants, and the peppers in the vegetable garden have withered.

examples.zh: 霜降杀百草，农民赶在霜前把庄稼收进仓里。
examples.en: Frost kills all the plants at Shuangjiang, so farmers rush to bring in the crops before it arrives.

usage.en: Describes the last solar term of autumn. Occasionally used figuratively for a cruel season or event that kills off the weak.
usage.zh: 描述秋季最后一个节气。有时比喻残酷的时节或事件淘汰弱者。

pinyin: lì dōng bǔ dōng, bǔ zuǐ kōng
literal: Winter Begins · nourish · winter, nourish · mouth · empty
natural: nourishing at the start of winter fills an empty mouth

meaning.en: At the start of winter people eat hearty, nourishing food; the second half jokes that the tonic is really just an excuse to eat well.
meaning.zh: 立冬时吃补身体的食物，后半句半开玩笑，说补冬不过是满足口腹之欲的借口。

equivalents: an excuse for a winter feast
winter tonics for the table

examples.zh: 立冬补冬，补嘴空，今晚我们去吃姜母鸭吧。
examples.en: Winter tonic fills an empty mouth, so let's go and have ginger duck tonight.

examples.zh: 妈妈说立冬补冬，补嘴空，炖了一大锅羊肉汤。
examples.en: Mum said it's the winter tonic that fills the mouth, and stewed a big pot of mutton soup.

usage.en: The 立冬 (Start of Winter) is about 7 November. 补冬 is a custom, especially in southern Fujian, Taiwan and Guangdong, of eating tonics such as mutton, ginger duck or chicken stew. The saying is humorous, not literally medical.
usage.zh: 立冬约在11月7日。“补冬”是闽南、台湾和广东等地的习俗，吃羊肉、姜母鸭或炖鸡等进补。这句话带诙谐意味，不是医学说法。

literal: Winter Solstice · big · as · New Year
natural: the winter solstice is as big as the New Year

meaning.en: The winter solstice (about 21 December) is celebrated as importantly as the lunar New Year, with family gatherings and special foods.
meaning.zh: 冬至（约12月21日）与春节一样重要，要家人团聚并吃特别的食物。

equivalents: the solstice is as big as New Year's
a festival worth a family reunion

examples.zh: 冬至大如年，不管多远都要回家吃团圆饭。
examples.en: The winter solstice is as big as New Year, so however far away you are, you go home for the reunion dinner.

examples.zh: 冬至大如年，奶奶一早就开始包汤圆。
examples.en: The winter solstice is as big as the New Year and grandma started making rice dumplings at dawn.

usage.en: Reflects the old custom of treating the winter solstice as the start of the new year cycle, as the sun begins to return. Especially strong in Jiangnan and southern China.
usage.zh: 反映古时把冬至视为新一年阳气回升的起点。在江南和华南地区尤为盛行。

pinyin: dōng zhì jiǎo zi xià zhì miàn
literal: Winter Solstice · dumplings · Summer Solstice · noodles
natural: dumplings at the winter solstice, noodles at the summer solstice

meaning.en: The northern Chinese custom is to eat dumplings on the winter solstice and noodles on the summer solstice.
meaning.zh: 北方习俗：冬至吃饺子，夏至吃面条。

equivalents: dumplings for winter, noodles for summer
what to eat on the solstices

examples.zh: 冬至饺子夏至面，今天是冬至，我们包饺子吧。
examples.en: Dumplings at the winter solstice and noodles at the summer solstice: today is the solstice, so let's make dumplings.

examples.zh: 我家一直遵守冬至饺子夏至面的习惯。
examples.en: My family has always kept the custom of dumplings in winter and noodles in summer.

usage.en: A custom, mainly in the north, with the saying that eating dumplings means 'your ears will not freeze'. It is not observed everywhere; the south has other foods, such as glutinous rice balls.
usage.zh: 主要流行于北方，有“吃了饺子冬天耳朵不冻”之说。并非各地通行，南方还有汤圆等食俗。

pinyin: yī jiǔ èr jiǔ bù chū shǒu
literal: first nine · second nine · not · take out · hands
natural: in the first and second nines, hands stay hidden

meaning.en: In the first two nine-day periods after the winter solstice it is so cold that people keep their hands in their sleeves or pockets.
meaning.zh: 冬至后头两个“九”天气寒冷，人们把手缩在袖子或口袋里不愿伸出来。

equivalents: too cold to take your hands out
hands in pockets weather

examples.zh: 一九二九不出手，今年冬天真冷。
examples.en: In the first and second nines no hands come out, and this winter is really cold.

examples.zh: 一九二九不出手，早上上学手都不敢伸出来。
examples.en: Nobody takes their hands out in the first two nines, and I dared not take mine out on the way to school.

usage.en: From the 九九歌 'Nine-Nines Song': the 81 days after the winter solstice are counted in nine groups of nine, each with its own weather proverb. The line goes on 三九四九冰上走.
usage.zh: 出自“九九歌”：冬至后的81天分为九个“九”，每个“九”各有谚语。下句为“三九四九冰上走”。

pinyin: sān jiǔ sì jiǔ bīng shàng zǒu
literal: third nine · fourth nine · ice · on · walk
natural: in the third and fourth nines people walk on ice

meaning.en: During the third and fourth nine-day periods after the winter solstice it is the coldest time of year and rivers freeze solid.
meaning.zh: 冬至后的第三、四个“九”是一年中最冷的时候，河水结厚冰，人可以在冰上行走。

equivalents: the coldest days of winter
the depths of winter

examples.zh: 三九四九冰上走，湖面已经结冰，孩子们都去滑冰了。
examples.en: In the third and fourth nines you can walk on the ice: the lake has frozen and the children all went skating.

examples.zh: 三九四九冰上走，出门一定要戴好帽子手套。
examples.en: In the depths of winter you can walk on the ice, so always wear a hat and gloves.

usage.en: The coldest period, 三九 (the third nine) in particular, usually falls in early to mid-January. Part of the 九九歌 'Nine-Nines Song'; it is also the second half of 一九二九不出手.
usage.zh: 最冷的时期，尤其“三九”，通常在1月上中旬。属“九九歌”，也是“一九二九不出手”的下句。

text: 日落胭脂红，无雨便是风
pinyin: rì luò yān zhī hóng, wú yǔ biàn shì fēng
variants: 日落胭脂红，无雨也有风
literal: sun · set · rouge · red, no · rain · then · is · wind
natural: if the sunset is rouge-red, there will be wind if not rain

meaning.en: A deep red sunset foretells wind or rain the next day.
meaning.zh: 日落时天空红得像胭脂，预示次日有风或雨。

equivalents: a fiery sunset means wind or rain
a red evening sky foretells a change

examples.zh: 日落胭脂红，无雨便是风，明天出海要当心。
examples.en: A rouge-red sunset means wind if not rain, so be careful going to sea tomorrow.

examples.zh: 爷爷看着晚霞说，日落胭脂红，无雨便是风。
examples.en: Looking at the sunset glow, grandpa said that a rouge-red sunset means wind or rain.

usage.en: A folk weather rule: very red evening clouds mean much dust or moisture in the air, which can signal a change in the weather. It is not always reliable and varies by region; note that this contradicts the English rule 'red sky at night, shepherd's delight'.
usage.zh: 民间看天经验：晚霞特别红说明空气中尘埃或水汽多，天气可能变化。并不总是可靠，各地也不同；与英语“晚霞红，牧羊人喜”的说法相反。

synonyms: 朝霞不出门，晚霞行千里

pinyin: yàn zi dī fēi, dà yǔ jiāng zhì
variants: 燕子低飞蛇过道，不久大雨到
literal: swallows · low · fly, heavy · rain · about to · arrive
natural: when swallows fly low, heavy rain is coming

meaning.en: Swallows flying close to the ground are a sign that rain is on its way.
meaning.zh: 燕子低飞，预示大雨即将来临。

equivalents: swallows flying low mean rain
signs of rain in the animal world

examples.zh: 燕子低飞，大雨将至，赶紧收衣服！
examples.en: The swallows are flying low, so rain is coming: bring in the washing quickly!

examples.zh: 燕子低飞，大雨将至，农民加快了收割速度。
examples.en: With swallows flying low and heavy rain on the way, the farmers sped up the harvest.

usage.en: Before rain the air is humid and insects fly lower, so the swallows that feed on them follow. The fuller folk version is 燕子低飞蛇过道，不久大雨到.
usage.zh: 下雨前空气潮湿，昆虫低飞，捕食的燕子也随之低飞。民间较完整的说法是“燕子低飞蛇过道，不久大雨到”。
